about_the_game:
ONE CHARACTER, TWO PLAYERS

Input offers a unique platforming experience where control is split between two players.
One player manages movement, the other handles actions. Perfect coordination is the only way forward.

TIMING IS EVERYTHING

A single mistimed input means failure. Levels are designed to push your reflexes and teamwork to the limit.

PARKOUR AND PLATFORMING CHALLENGES

Run, jump, cling to walls, and overcome obstacles. Parkour-inspired levels will test both your speed and your cooperation.

ONE MOVES, THE OTHER ACTS

Input is built exclusively for two players. With one responsible for movement and the other for actions, every step requires flawless collaboration.

MINIMALIST DESIGN

A clean, stylized aesthetic keeps your focus on the gameplay itself. Each level is a clear but demanding challenge.

KEY FEATURES

  • One character controlled by two players.

  • Parkour-inspired, challenging platforming levels.

  • Gameplay based entirely on timing and coordination.

  • Minimalist visuals with a focused design.

  • High replayability.

🔑 Input looks simple but mastering it is anything but easy. Without true cooperation, no obstacle can be overcome.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3,3 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 6 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 @ 3,2 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
